meta.name: high-end-visual-design
meta.description: Teaches the AI to design like a high-end agency. Defines the exact fonts, spacing, shadows, card structures, and animations that make a website feel expensive. Blocks all the common defaults that make AI designs look cheap or generic.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让网页设计拥有高端品牌质感
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想让AI生成的设计摆脱廉价感、更像专业工作室出品。
copy.tagline_en: Make web designs feel premium and agency-crafted
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want AI-generated designs to look expensive and professional.

howto.what: Claude 生成网页界面时改用高端设计工作室的做法:指定字体、间距、阴影、卡片嵌套结构和缓动曲线,避开 Inter、Roboto 等默认字体及灰边框、生硬阴影。产出 React/Tailwind 或 HTML 代码。
howto.when: 当你要它做网站界面、UI 组件或生成 React/Tailwind/HTML 前端代码时触发;它会先选定一种视觉与布局原型,再动手写代码。

say.text: 帮我做一个 SaaS 落地页,要深黑玻璃质感加不对称 Bento 卡片布局
say.note: 它会先选定视觉与布局原型再产出代码

say.text: 用双层层叠卡片做一个作品集页面,元素滚动进入时淡入上浮
say.note: 滚动进入视口的元素执行淡入上浮

say.text: 把导航栏做成悬浮玻璃胶囊,点汉堡图标变形成 X 并展开全屏菜单
say.note: 展开态为全屏毛玻璃遮罩菜单

howto.what_en: Claude writes web UI using high-end agency rules: chosen fonts, spacing, shadows, nested card structures and easing curves, avoiding default fonts like Inter or Roboto and flat gray borders. Outputs React/Tailwind/HTML code.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for a website UI, UI components, or React/Tailwind/HTML front-end code; it first picks one visual and layout archetype, then builds.

say_en.text: Build a SaaS landing page with OLED-black glass and asymmetric bento cards
say_en.note: It picks a vibe and layout archetype first

say_en.text: Make a portfolio page with double-bezel cards that fade up on scroll
say_en.note: Elements fade up as they enter the viewport

say_en.text: Floating glass pill navbar; hamburger morphs to X with a full-screen menu
say_en.note: Opens as a full-screen blurred overlay menu
